data.title: Wall Street and crypto clash in the growing markets as stablecoins and tokenized assets blur lines between banks and exchanges.
data.description: The increasing popularity of stablecoins and tokenized assets is leading banks, exchanges, and crypto companies to compete in overlapping markets, including payments, stocks, and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). This convergence is highlighting the growing presence of digital assets in traditional finance sectors.

data.title: 2026 IMS | IASO Bio Presents First-in-Human Phase 1 Data of RD140, a Fully Human BCMA/GPRC5D Dual-Targeted FasT CAR-T
data.description: A poster presentation has been chosen for the poster discussion session with Abstract No. PA-200. The presentation discusses a first-in-human study involving 9 heavily pretreated, high-risk patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma or plasma cell leukemia. The study focuses on RD140, which is a fully human BCMA/GPRC5D dual-targeted FasT CAR-T therapy.

data.title: New ProWood Product Named BobVila.com 2026 Tool of the Year Award Winner
data.description: ProWood®, a leading company, recently announced that their latest product, the 4x4 Deck Railing Post, has been awarded the prestigious BobVila.com 2027 Tool of the Year Award. The news, released on 25-Sep-2026 through PR Newswire, highlights the company's success in developing innovative products. This recognition marks a significant achievement for ProWood® and showcases their dedication to excellence in the industry.

data.title: AMG Critical Materials N.V. Publishes Annex IX Information Document ahead of Listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange
data.description: In Amsterdam on September 25, 2026, AMG Critical Materials N.V. shared an Annex IX info document related to its shares being listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under EURONEXT AMSTERDAM: “AMG”. This move is in accordance with Article 1(5)(ba) of Regulation (EU) 2017/1129. The decision to pursue a listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange was revealed on August 24, 2026.

data.title: LARRY KUDLOW TO HOST FOX NEWS CHANNEL'S SUNDAY MORNING FUTURES THROUGH MIDTERM ELECTIONS
data.description: Larry Kudlow will take over as host of Sunday Morning Futures on FOX Business Network from September 27th until November 8th. The show airs every Sunday from 10 to 11 AM Eastern Time.
